name: dsh-lan-access
description: DSH web profile bundle: makes the Web GUI work over plain-http LAN IPs (polyfills crypto.randomUUID), optionally lets privileged settings/preset methods work from LAN hosts (allowPrivilegedFromLan), and adds an opt-in password gate with first-use setup and in-web password change (authEnabled).

scripts.test: node --check lib/index.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "import('./lib/index.mjs').then(m => { if (m.name !== 'secure-context-polyfill') throw new Error('bad name'); if (typeof m.apply !== 'function') throw new Error('bad apply'); console.log('plugin exports OK'); })"
